name: Magical Witch☆Bell Kage
original_name: マジカルウィッチ☆ベルカゲ
source:
After school one day, Himawari, who came to the club room as usual, suddenly became a magical girl for some reason!

Her companions are another magical girl who can't be trusted and a pitiful fairy companion who will die if she can't fulfill her orders.

Let's work together to collect magical power and defeat the boss who plans to conquer the world!

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/2023_4_1.html]official website[/url]]
